bio: This little place, the origins of which date back to some time between the 15C and 16C, stands halfway between the cathedral and the Maine River. Chef Thony Pohu turns out generous and flavoursome cuisine that is in tune with the times and the seasons and has a strong emphasis on plants. The high-quality ingredients are sourced locally, and the suppliers are featured prominently on the menu. The wine list boasts over 300 labels, mostly organic and natural....
